security_contract.active_tenant: tenant.context plus exact active-tenant slug match
security_contract.idor: site is resolved by active tenant_id plus route site id; foreign tenant/site returns 404
security_contract.validation: only username and application_password are accepted; caller identity/status overrides fail closed
security_contract.csrf: web POST form includes CSRF token
security_contract.ownership: tenant_id, site_id, site URL and persistence target are derived server-side
security_contract.secret_non_exposure: Application Password is held only for verification/persistence, encrypted by SiteCredential cast, hidden from serialization, omitted from old input, HTML, status and evidence
security_contract.truthful_success: proposed credential is verified against live WordPress REST before persistence; success is emitted only after encrypted upsert and authoritative reread
security_contract.retry_idempotency: unique tenant/site credential row is updated under transaction/lock; repeat success cannot create duplicates
security_contract.provider_failure: HTTP/auth/timeout/invalid response fails closed and preserves any existing credential
security_contract.fake_success: production verifier performs a real WordPress REST users/me request; no sample/demo provider state is accepted
